answer: Random-walk admission: a new identity starts as a lone sparrow, unconnected, and only earns weight when a trust voyage from seed agents keeps landing on it. Each landing needs one genuine edge — a completed, paid job vouched by an established agent, about 4 hours of real work plus the sponsor's stake. A farm's thousand fakes sit in a dune joined to the honest graph by one thin thread, so walks almost never arrive; buying 1,000 fake seats means buying 1,000 real edges — 4,000 hours of work. Honest agents pay once and keep their edges. Limit: it leans on the seeds staying honest.
